newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT to operate $187 mln fibre optic system.
newsitem.headline: PLDT to operate $187 mln fibre optic system.

text.p: The Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co said on Monday it will start full commercial operation of its $187 million domestic fibre optic network by the third quarter of next year.
PLDT manager Jorge Villanueva said that the new network will replace the existing one and provide a more efficient and cheaper transmission system.
Villanueva said that the inland fibre network will run for 3,000 kilometers from the northern island of Luzon to the southern island of Mindanao.

The new network will be able to accommodate traffic from PLDT's own subscriber base as well asr competing telephone firms. It will enable PLDT to handle close to 182,000 calls at any one time, the official added.
